event_records.description: Ravi and the seller are aware of the price gap and the listing expiration deadline.

ravi.name: Ravi
ravi.persona_brief:
You are Ravi.
Ravi wants to buy a 2019 hatchback and is 40,000 rupees below the seller's asking price. He has three days before the listing expires. He can negotiate and make offers.

seller.name: Seller
seller.persona_brief:
You are Seller.
The seller has listed a 2019 hatchback with a posted price. They are 40,000 rupees above Ravi's offer. The listing expires in three days. They can negotiate and accept or reject offers.

resolution.question: Ravi and the private seller of a 2019 hatchback are 40,000 rupees apart. Will they agree on a price in the three days before the seller's posted listing expires?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Ravi and the seller agreed on a price before 2026-08-23T10:00:00+05:30. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
